reusable_knowledge: MPS-2 (Mall Parking System) belongs in parking/, not mps/. The mps/ package is the unrelated Master Production Schedule ERP engine.

Parking module layout: parking/app/config.py has ParkingConfiguration (capacity, grace_period_minutes, hourly_rate_paise, daily_cap_paise, lost_ticket_fee_paise, currency, version) and ConfigStore.active(); parking/app/ticket.py has STATUS_OPEN, ParkingTicket, TicketStore, Occupancy, TicketService.enter/get, normalize_vehicle_number, and LotFullError; parking/app/main.py provides the CLI; parking/tests/test_entry.py has 20 tests.

TicketService.enter is atomic and idempotent: an idempotency-key hit returns the existing ticket before the capacity check, and ticket creation plus occupancy increment happen together; duplicate ticket IDs abort without changing occupancy.

MPS-2 CLI: `python -m parking.app --capacity N` accepts a single JSON object or a list of objects from stdin or a file; a single successful entry exits 0, a single LOT_FULL exits 1, invalid payloads exit 2, and batch mode emits per-item results including inline LOT_FULL.
CONF-MPS-002 suggests POST/GET /api/v1/tickets, but the MPS-2 acceptance criteria do not require HTTP; a CLI-only interface is a valid documented choice consistent with repository conventions.

Future MPS seams: ParkingTicket.entry_time/status and config grace/hourly_rate_paise/daily_cap_paise/currency/version support MPS-3 fee calculation; Occupancy currently has no decrement() and will need one for MPS-4; capacity and occupancy feed MPS-6 availability.
The in-repo jira/MPS-2.json is authoritative and supersedes the external fixture and mps/ assumptions recorded in stale failed episode 29ddb6fe.
